confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Philadelphia price levels for a July 2026 window; no live booking pages or current menus were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because summer demand and event-driven rate spikes vary widely. The FX observation came from search-result text describing the RBA exchange rates overview page and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large mid-Atlantic and Northeast US cities with comparable restaurant, bar, and lodging price levels, such as Boston, Baltimore, and Washington DC. Drink prices are set from local beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine ratios where direct knowledge was weaker.
